programmes.d: Morgan gets a crash course in extreme winter flying; Marty battles a predator invasion; Tom faces a new wolf threat; Jake and his hounds hunt a rogue lion.
Tom takes the fight to the wolves; a lion chase claims a casualty; Morgan builds bigger, and Eustace goes to battle to defend his land.
Marty brings in a record haul; Margaret's extreme flight training leaves her out in the cold, Tom puts his master craftsmen skills to work, and Jake chases his next meal.
Tom returns to the field on a rescue mission; The deep freeze leaves Morgan and Margaret scrambling for water; Eustace takes on a risky payday in a bid to buy his neighbor's land.
After meeting with a young fisherman who was violently bitten by a monster barracuda, Cyril searches the Florida Keys to find this toothy torpedo, and to learn more about these ferocious hunters.

Deep in the dark waters of the Amazon jungle lives a fanged creature that could have been born in your worst nightmares - the vampire fish. To track down this monstrous-looking predator, Cyril embarks on a rugged expedition that will put him to the test.
Two massive prehistoric monsters are better than one, so Cyril travels to the dangerous swamps and wild coast of Louisiana to track down a pair of predators that hunt its murky waters.

Cyril has come to the remote jungle rivers of Nicaragua on a mission to catch one of the most explosive fish on the planet. Weighing over 300 pounds and measuring 8 feet long, the tarpon is a real primitive titan.

Growing to over 1400 lbs, the blue fin tuna is a true titan prowling the oceans, and it's extremely powerful and fast. To help protect these endangered giants, Cyril is recruited by a team of biologists to travel up the East Coast of the USA and Canada.

A mid-winter melt threatens to derail Tom's season; Eustace masters gravity to keep the water flowing at home; Jason and Mary make a move to feed their growing family.

The crew witnesses the destructive power of a Typhon. A huge thunderstorm forces the men to take shelter in a remote village.
South China Sea conditions continue to assault the team. Checking the men and their Jet Ski out of Malaysia and into Thailand becomes a major problem.
The men enter a remote village in Thailand. Armed security forces approach the team. The expedition’s final destination is just out of reach!
